rules.sentence: Orbital pseudotumor, also known as orbital inflammatory pseudotumor (OIP), idiopathic orbital inflammation (IOI), or idiopathic orbital inflammatory syndrome (IOIS), is a benign, noninfectious, nonneoplastic, space-occupying, inflammatory condition of the orbit and peri-orbit without identifiable local or systemic causes.
Screen patients with orbital symptoms for signs of orbital pseudotumor, including a thorough history and physical examination.
Implement evidence-based treatment strategies for diagnosing and managing orbital pseudotumor.
